newsitem.title: UK: Fire sweeps Avengers film set near London.
newsitem.headline: Fire sweeps Avengers film set near London.

text.p: A blaze on Friday at Pinewood film studios west of London damaged a 1.5 million pound ($2.4 million) set where a screen version of the cult television series "The Avengers" is being filmed, the film's producer said.
Jerry Weintraub told Reuters that neither of the main stars of the movie, Ralph Fiennes and Uma Thurman, was on the huge set at the time.
Ambulance officials said one firefighter was treated in hospital for smoke inhalation.
The local fire brigade said eight fire engines were tackling the blaze, which a spokeswoman described as extensive.
She said the blaze apparently started in the roof of the hangar-like building, which measures 150 metres by 100 metres.
Weintraub said it was too early to assess the extent of the damage to the set and whether it would delay production of the Warner Brothers film, which was due to be completed in September.
"It's a serious blow, but as long as nobody dies or gets severely injured, then we'll get over it," Weintraub said. "The Avengers always deal with everything." ($ = 0.613 British Pounds)
